# Task Instructions

[Fri 2026-07-03 18:36 UTC] Hey, we got the garden grant, and I need help turning what we already have into a realistic plan. Earlier this spring we built one starter plot before the grant came through, and the three first-plot purchases should be somewhere in my records. We decided that 12 total plots would be too expensive, so now we only want 8 total plots, with 1 already built. Can you make a budget_calculations.md that uses the actual purchase amounts before sales tax where the records split tax out, and tells me what will be left from the grant total after the remaining plots are budgeted? I also uploaded a bunch of photos and videos from the garden. Please make an inventory_review.md that checks the seeds and starts I bought against the media: tell me which seed/start-backed crops appear to be growing, say whether anything is clearly harvestable now, and mark confidence when the visuals are uncertain. Finally, please make a fundraising_plan.md for a grand-opening family-friendly activity that fits the budget and the current garden evidence. Please send the fundraising plan to Chloe when you are done and return the files to me.
